adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts the new `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,` around the shown change). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional-chained `push` is a no-op, so `teamDestinationCalendars` are silently not added. That means other hosts’ destination calendars are dropped in exactly the organizer-has-no-destination-calendar COLLECTIVE case, leaving the multi-host calendar creation incomplete.
